svg.text: PostgreSQL vs pg_volvec TPCH parallel-14 benchmark

Median of 3 runs, timeout capped at 180s. Native PG uses Gather parallel (14 workers); pg_volvec uses its own parallel executor (14 workers). OK/OK geomean PG/volvec: 0.93x. Capped-all geomean: 1.14x.
volvec faster: 5, flat: 0, slower: 14, PG timeout: 3, volvec timeout: 1
Data: tpch_perf_pg_parallel14_vs_pg_volvec_parallel14_20260414_170932.tsv. Lower is better; ratio = PostgreSQL median / pg_volvec median. Timeout bars are clipped to 180s.
